title: share product SEED-Share-Prod-2 list row: unit 100.00 vs capital 1.00 (column discriminator)
_note: share-product seam, PRODUCT LIST ROW. request.share_capital "1.00" is shares-products-list-raw.json pageItems[1].shareCapital for product id 2 (SEED-Share-Prod-2), the exact decimal text the oracle stored, distinct from the 100000.00 capital of product id 3; expect.share_capital_minor "100" is its minor-unit form. request.unit_price "100.00" is pageItems[1].unitPrice and expect.unit_price_minor "10000" its minor-unit form. request.total_shares 1000 is pageItems[1].totalShares. This row discriminates the money COLUMN the list serialiser fills: unit price and share capital differ, so a transposed-money-column defect goes red on this vector.

provenance.note: transcribed from .softhouse/capture/shares/out/shares-products-list-raw.json (product id 2, pageItems[1]): unitPrice 100.00, shareCapital 1.00, totalShares 1000.
